newsitem.title: USA: AT&T in talks with SBC - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: AT&T in talks with SBC - WSJ.

text.p: AT&T Corp is in the midst of merger talks with SBC Communications Corp, seeking to fashion a deal that could be worth at least $50 billion, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Tuesday's editions, the Journal said negotiators were struggling over the financial structure of such a deal, including the new company's management, its name and base of operations.
The Journal quoted unnamed sources close to the negotiations as saying confirmation of the talks could come soon as an agreement came closer.
"The discussions have grown very serious in the last month," one source said.
The two telecommunications companies combined would have nearly $80 billion in annual revenue, 230,000 workers and more than 60 percent of the United States' long-distance market.
The Journal said roadblocks exist to such a merger, however, including anti-trust scrutiny and resistance from competitors in long-distance and local services.
